v13_container_inspect.description: Places a chest with known contents and a second empty chest, then inspects both. Contents are set by the bundle so the expected result is known before the run rather than read off the screen afterwards.

v13_not_a_container.description: A plain block must be refused with a pointer to the NBT command, not reported as an empty container. An empty chest and a stone block are different facts.

v13_cleanup.description: Removes what the check placed. Re-runnable.
